hypothesis: Single-winner leveraged ETF selection leaves idiosyncratic variance too high for the cumulative Bonferroni hurdle. Equal-gross top-k portfolios across thirteen liquid leveraged and sector ETFs may preserve cross-sectional residual alpha while diversifying daily noise and raising whole-sample IR.
version_contract: ten fixed factor mechanisms times ten non-overlapping decision-exit schedules; each version selects among top-k 2/3/4/6, three thresholds, and two causal volatility targets using only development data
